question: With original samples fixed, how do finite bootstrap count and tail resolution relate to endpoint variability, and does small-sample undercoverage remain when endpoints stabilize?

randomness.prefix: one length-4999 bootstrap mean vector per original/inner pair; B199 and B999 are prefixes, never separately generated; recompute z0 and adjusted q from each prefix
randomness.pairing: percentile and BCa share each prefix; t and acceleration are computed once per original sample and stay unchanged over B/k
randomness.independence: distinct keyed original and inner streams; independent original samples are the population-repetition units, not K or B; seed IDs do not replace an independence explanation

methods.definitions: preserve RQ-M02: half-tie z0, delete-one jackknife acceleration, linear empirical quantiles, no clipping/fallback, same BCa denominator/order validity conditions
methods.truth_separation: inference receives samples/bootstrap means/alpha only; truth 0 is used solely by evaluation
methods.tail: endpoint tau=B*min(q,1-q); either tau<10 is an interval warning, not invalidity or exclusion
methods.maximum_B: 4999 is not truth, infinite-B answer, or an error reference

metrics.A: sqrt((sample Var_k(lower)+sample Var_k(upper))/2)/se, ddof=1, finite-K operational metric; not RMSE or an unbiased conditional SD estimator
metrics.coverage: per-original C_i=mean_k I(lower<=0<=upper), never coverage of an averaged-endpoint interval
metrics.width_warning: average widths/warnings within original first, then average over independent originals
metrics.summary_unit: R=100 per seed, 300 pooled originals; never Wilson or sd/sqrt(R*K)
metrics.t_reference: stored K copies are display references; interval counts/validity use only R original t intervals, endpoint SD/A are exactly zero if valid
metrics.intervals: 99% original-level mean t intervals; zero variance makes decision interval undefined; no clipping to rate range
metrics.B999_vs_B4999: descriptive paired original-level C differences; a nonsignificant difference is not equivalence

H1_n5.support: pooled 99% upper<0 and each seed mean<0

H1_n20.support: pooled 99% upper<0 and each seed mean<0

H2.classify: W=1 iff at least 5 of k0..9 have tail_warning; required classification intervals must all be valid
H2.evaluate: A_eval from only independent k10..19, ddof=1; never reuse classification endpoints for A_eval
H2.interval: 99% original-level Welch t interval with Satterthwaite df; undefined for zero SE
H2.groups: each pooled group >=30 originals; each seed each group >=5; insufficiency =>inconclusive, no R/K/threshold changes
H2.support: pooled lower>.02 and each seed difference>.02, all group-size/validity requirements satisfied
H2.interpretation: association of differing originals, not causal effect of warnings

H3.quantity: mean over 300 independent originals of C_i from K20 coverage indicators
H3.support: pooled 99% upper<.93 and each seed mean<.93

hypotheses.decision: 4 quantities with 99% intervals, approximate multiplicity control, not exact simultaneous guarantee; original-level t intervals for H1/H3, Welch for H2
hypotheses.status: supported iff all interval/seed/validity/group requirements hold; wholly opposite interval =>not_supported; touching/straddling threshold, unmet seed conditions, invalid/incomplete or insufficient groups =>inconclusive. Preserve contrary evidence alongside missingness. H1 retains each n; either clearly not_supported makes overall H1 not_supported

invalid_policy.original: se<=0/nonfinite or undefined method intervals are reason-labelled; any required invalid K makes that original main A/C/width/warning metrics NA
invalid_policy.aggregate: any missing original needed for a confirmatory comparison makes its main estimate/interval NA and decision inconclusive; do not treat invalid as noncoverage
invalid_policy.conditional: jointly complete originals only may have conditional_ reference estimates with explicit finite-count denominators; never silently drop invalids

saved_schema.sample_hash: SHA256 over little-endian float64 C-order original vector bytes
saved_schema.retain: original vectors/IDs/hashes, endpoints, z0/a/q/tau, valid/reason/warnings; no full bootstrap mean/index arrays

execution.main: once only; no redraw on unsupported/inconclusive/group shortage/timeout
execution.smoke: one separately authorized namespace smoke: 12cells,R2,K4,prefix B19/49/99;24 originals,96 inner streams,9504 bootstrap samples; no scientific decisions
execution.correction: only actual code bug permits at most one separately authorized rerun, retaining reason/old source/old outputs; cumulative main wall<=600s
execution.budget_stop: preserve complete/incomplete cells, no automatic scale changes or retries
